item.title: Oma Bluefin Tuna: Japan's Prized Catch — Aomori Guide
item.description: Oma bluefin tuna, line-caught off Cape Oma at the very northern tip of Honshu, is among the most prized fish in Japan — a single Oma tuna once sold for record millions at Tokyo’s market. At the port, you can eat this melt-in-the-mouth ‘black diamond’ as sashimi and sushi, straight from the source. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Oma, Shimokita, Aomori Hours Restaurant hours (some seasonal) Admission Varies; premium tuna sets Time needed About 1 hour Best time Autumn–winter (peak tuna season) What to Try Melt-in-the-mouth Oma bluefin sashimi and sushi.
